references.label: Six flashing Rebel targets
references.description: Six standup targets that light the return lanes, spinners, and pop bumpers when completed.

references.label: Four starship lanes
references.description: Upper rollover lanes that raise Bonus X when completed; the right flipper moves the lit lane.

references.label: Left Darth Vader drop bank
references.description: Three drops that build the award collected with lit Planet Dagobah.

references.label: Planet Dagobah collect
references.description: Collect shot for the left drop-bank value plus the current bonus when lit.

references.label: Planet Bespin collect
references.description: Collect shot for the advancing Bespin award when lit.

references.label: Right-hand drop target
references.description: Target that opens the ball-exit lane and scores 50,000 when flashing.
